title: Kenji with a little more realism, round 1
question: Which of these, if any, should become Kenji's new base portrait?

media.caption: At the size the game shows portraits (desktop, every face the same height, chins level): Mio, Emi, Aoi, Kuro, Mori and Kenji as they are now, then the five renders I kept. Mori's reworked candidates are in Review mori-2.

Every render of this round in order, framed at the game's portrait scale, after the current portrait. The one change is a little more realism, after your "Kenji is fine, maybe give him a little bit more realism". Passes 1 to 3 drew him fresh from words: the faces got more realistic, but all 12 came out with bodybuilder arms and chest, and neither the muscle exclusion (pass 2) nor softer build words (pass 3) changed that. Passes 4 and 5 start from the current portrait instead (img2img at 0.6 and 0.7), which keeps him and his soft build and lets the face, neck and shirt become more natural. Hair, shirt, tie and lanyard are as now; seeds 1 to 4 in every pass. The badges carry random letters, as the current one does.
